comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: It's a land battle item, it puts your foe into disorder status so they cant use neither items nor battle techs on you. Very useful but the only main reliable way to get them is by making them though alchemy, which makes them hard to come by. It does drop in FSD mid (not sure about other dungeons), though again it's rare.
